recognize_zh: 切片中大片淡紫色、邊界模糊的上皮樣組織球，核呈卵圓形、染色質淡，周圍混有小淋巴球與一些深色顆粒狀色素，構成非壞死性肉芽腫的樣貌。
features: Sheets of epithelioid histiocytes with abundant pale cytoplasm and indistinct borders
Oval to elongated vesicular nuclei with fine chromatin and small nucleoli
Scattered to clustered small lymphocytes with dense round nuclei, denser at the right edge
Occasional dark brown-black granular pigment deposits, likely hemosiderin or artifact
No caseous necrosis or definite multinucleated giant cells in this field
describe_en: Section shows a poorly demarcated aggregate of epithelioid histiocytes with abundant pale cytoplasm and oval vesicular nuclei, admixed with numerous small lymphocytes. Scattered coarse dark granular pigment is present. There is no necrosis, and multinucleated giant cells are not definitively identified in this field. The tinctorial quality suggests a Giemsa-type or faded hematoxylin stain, which limits cytoplasmic detail. Findings are consistent with non-necrotizing granulomatous inflammation, compatible with sarcoidosis once infection is excluded.

ddx.vs: Tuberculous granulomas typically have central caseous necrosis and acid-fast bacilli on Ziehl-Neelsen stain, neither of which is present here.
Histoplasma shows small intracellular yeasts within macrophages on GMS/PAS stains, which should be sought in any marrow granuloma.

ddx.dx: Peripheral T-cell lymphoma with epithelioid histiocytes (Lennert type)
ddx.vs: Lennert lymphoma contains atypical small-to-medium T cells with irregular nuclei between histiocytic clusters and shows clonal TCR rearrangement.
